mapper.select: SELECT C.CMNT_SN , C.PRNT_CMNT_SN , CASE WHEN C.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DEL_FLAG , CASE WHEN C.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE C.CMNT_CN END AS CMNT_CN , CASE WHEN C.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE C.MBR_SN END AS MBR_SN , CASE WHEN C.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE M.MBR_NCNM END AS MBR_NCNM , CASE WHEN C.SYS_AUTO_CRT_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS SYS_AUTO_CRT_FLAG , CASE WHEN C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS OWNER_FLAG , C.REG_DT FROM CMNT C JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = C.MBR_SN JOIN CMNT RT ON RT.CMNT_SN = COALESCE(C.PRNT_CMNT_SN, C.CMNT_SN) WHERE C.PST_SN = #{pstSn} ORDER BY CASE WHEN RT.SYS_AUTO_CRT_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , COALESCE(C.PRNT_CMNT_SN, C.CMNT_SN) , C.PRNT_CMNT_SN IS NOT NULL , C.REG_DT , C.CMNT_SN
SELECT CMNT_SN , PRNT_CMNT_SN , PST_SN , MBR_SN , CMNT_CN , SYS_AUTO_CRT_YN , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM CMNT WHERE CMNT_SN = #{cmntSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CMNT ( PRNT_CMNT_SN , PST_SN , MBR_SN , CMNT_CN , SYS_AUTO_CRT_YN , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{prntCmntSn} , #{pstSn} , #{mbrSn} , #{cmntCn} , 'N' , 'N' , NOW() , NOW() )

mapper.update: UPDATE CMNT SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE CMNT_SN = #{cmntSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
